mapper.select: SELECT year, extreme_type AS extremeType, SUM(occurrence_count) AS totalCount, AVG(threshold_value) AS thresholdValue FROM ads_weather_extreme GROUP BY year, extreme_type ORDER BY year ASC

SELECT season, SUM(CASE WHEN extreme_type = 'EXTREME_HIGH' THEN occurrence_count ELSE 0 END) AS highCount, SUM(CASE WHEN extreme_type = 'EXTREME_LOW' THEN occurrence_count ELSE 0 END) AS lowCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN extreme_type = 'EXTREME_HIGH' THEN avg_intensity END), 3) AS highAvgIntensity, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN extreme_type = 'EXTREME_LOW' THEN avg_intensity END), 3) AS lowAvgIntensity FROM ads_weather_extreme GROUP BY season ORDER BY FIELD(season, '春', '夏', '秋', '冬')
SELECT year, month, season, extreme_type AS extremeType, SUM(occurrence_count) AS occurrenceCount FROM ads_weather_extreme GROUP BY year, month, extreme_type ORDER BY year ASC, month ASC
SELECT year, extreme_type AS extremeType, ROUND(AVG(avg_intensity), 4) AS avgIntensity FROM ads_weather_extreme GROUP BY year, extreme_type ORDER BY year, extreme_type
SELECT year, extreme_type AS extremeType, SUM(occurrence_count) AS totalCount FROM ads_weather_extreme GROUP BY year, extreme_type ORDER BY year, extreme_type
SELECT year, month, extreme_type AS extremeType, ROUND(AVG(avg_intensity), 4) AS avgIntensity FROM ads_weather_extreme GROUP BY year, month, extreme_type ORDER BY year ASC, month ASC
